recheck.text: Whether the documentation and release records describe the change: docs/api.md (endpoint, ticket field, filter, audit action, notification), README command-line columns, a CHANGELOG.md section with a version bump in package.json, and a decision record if a format or rule changed.

defects.title: An agent name holding invalid UTF-8 is accepted and silently stored with a replacement character
defects.repro: Start the service; POST /tickets {"title":"t","requester":"r@x.com"}; printf '{"assignee":"da\xffna"}' | curl -X PUT localhost:PORT/tickets/T-0001/assignee -H "content-type: application/json" --data-binary @-; GET /tickets/T-0001
defects.observed: 200; assignee is "da\ufffdna"; an audit entry and a ticket.assigned notification to "da\ufffdna" are recorded
defects.expected: 400 invalid and the ticket unchanged (the inventory's acceptable outcome; docs/api.md says text that is not valid Unicode is invalid). The same decoding already applied to titles in the base version.

defects.title: No CHANGELOG section or version bump for the assignment feature
defects.repro: In the delivered tree read CHANGELOG.md and package.json "version"; compare with CONTRIBUTING.md ("Bump the version in package.json and add a section to CHANGELOG.md in the same pull request").
defects.observed: CHANGELOG.md ends at 1.4.0 (2025-09-15) with nothing about assignment; package.json version is 1.4.0, as in the base.
defects.expected: A new CHANGELOG section describing PUT /tickets/:id/assignee, the assignee field and filter, the notification and the CLI column, with a matching version bump.

defects.title: A malformed percent-encoded byte in the assignee filter matches an agent whose name holds U+FFFD
defects.repro: Start the service; POST /tickets {"title":"t","requester":"r"}; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee {"assignee":"Da\ufffdna"} -> 200; GET /tickets?assignee=Da%FFna
defects.observed: 200 with T-0001 in items (the invalid byte is decoded to the replacement character and matches the stored name)
defects.expected: 400 invalid or an empty page, as the PUT body already refuses malformed UTF-8 and the builders' spec C-52 requires
